events.title: Shadowstone | 0.9.0 Update
events.summary: What’s NewTalent TreesWe've overhauled our hero metaprogression from a linear track of rewards to a series of hero-specific talent trees. Each talent tree consists of 25 rewards that you unlock over time, and offer a mix of variety upgrades (adds more content to pools) and power upgrades (gives you a leg up on future runs). events.title: Shadowstone | Hero Feature: The Witch
events.summary: The heroes of Shadowstone all share the same responsibility to survive, but each are equipped with unique abilities that can be enhanced the further you delve into the biomes of the Sunderlands. Hexer, healer, and master of mushrooms The Witch is a support-focused Hero that has a wide array of tools for any situation. events.title: The Heroes of Shadowstone
events.summary: The world of Shadowstone is no place for comfort, and you’ll need every trick in the book to survive the horrors that await. Fear not, for there are heroes that you can call upon to harness their power… for now. They are: The Witch: Heal, hex, and support your allies with a bevy of mushrooms and magic. events.summary: What’s NewNew HeroesThe RogueThe Rogue sneaks their way into Shadowstone as an unlockable character! The Rogue is a single-target damage dealer who excels with set-up from their team. They’ve received a new passive that allows them to deal extra damage and generate Dodge for themselves if they attack a target with a debuff, or if the Rogue has a buff; just like a traditional Rogue, they always want to attack with an advantage!
